items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: It was a drummer, wasn't there, Zeno? Henry Zeno.

ctx.x: I don't know if they were married again. I don't know if they were married or what. I ought to ask her sometime. I mean, I wonder if she was any relation to this.
It was a drummer, wasn't there, Zeno? Henry Zeno. I wonder if she was any relation to him.
They had a couple of Zenos around here. I usually call his mother Mrs. Lewis, but her real name is Mrs. Zeno, Alice Zeno. He might be a part.
